verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches the edges of this story: subscription changes are documented with control over "discounts, and trial handling" [recurly-docs-16], and coupons appear among exportable report data [recurly-docs-23], which implies coupons exist. Nothing describes setting up free trials, coupon or promo-code campaigns, or the trial-to-paid flow. missing for 10: free-trial configuration docs, promotion/redemption code support, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, trial-end notifications meeting card-network rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
